tasks.title: Kick-off & confirm scope
tasks.notes: Align on Phase 1 outcomes, ways of working and decision owners.

tasks.title: Collect daily + month-end exports
tasks.notes: Provide representative Sales Order Excel exports and explain critical fields and usage.

tasks.title: Confirm business requirements
tasks.notes: Capture users, daily/month-end workflows, fields, pain points and acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Set up middleware environment
tasks.notes: Prepare access, runtime, connectivity and deployment path.

tasks.title: Map fields & data source
tasks.notes: Map source fields to the view; confirm refresh and access assumptions.

tasks.title: Build first viewing screen
tasks.notes: Deliver a working first view using agreed sample data.

tasks.title: Enhance filters & key fields
tasks.notes: Add agreed search, filters and high-value fields.

tasks.title: Review prototype with Sales
tasks.notes: Walk through practical usage and record gaps or changes.

tasks.title: System and data validation
tasks.notes: Check data correctness, access, response and exception handling.

tasks.title: Prepare UAT scenarios
tasks.notes: Create day-to-day and month-end scenarios with expected results.

tasks.title: Run user testing & log feedback
tasks.notes: Test using agreed scenarios; log defects and improvement requests.

tasks.title: Fix critical issues & retest
tasks.notes: Resolve release-blocking defects and confirm retest results.

tasks.title: Go-live readiness & sign-off
tasks.notes: Confirm sign-off, support contact, known issues and rollback approach.

tasks.title: Go live & handover
tasks.notes: Deploy Phase 1 and hand over operating/support notes.

tasks.title: Confirm access and user list
tasks.notes: Confirm named users and required roles.

tasks.title: Agree support and escalation route
tasks.notes: Document support contact, response path and ownership after go-live.

tasks.title: Confirm acceptance criteria
tasks.notes: Define what must work for daily and month-end usage.
